poster.alt: Field-guide poster for the PDF Photo Contact Sheet: a 4:3 thumbnail grid where cover mode trims 43.75 percent of a portrait frame.

card1.alt: Highlight card: what cover mode removes from four frame shapes - 43.75 percent of a 3:4 portrait height, 25 percent of a square, 25 percent of a 16:9 width, and 0 percent from a native 4:3 frame.

card2.alt: Highlight card: the bundled example cell by cell - ten sample images at 4 columns by 3 rows give 12 cells per sheet, 10 cells used and 2 empty, with the header reading Sheet 1, items 1 to 10.

card3.alt: Highlight card: seven EXIF fields are read but only four lines are printed - camera, lens, aperture and ISO always print, while shutter speed, focal length and the capture timestamp are always cut.
